answer: Identity-bond decay: every agent posts a 100 POA bond, issued as one opal, and it sheds 2 POA per epoch unless verified work restores it. A hollow identity doing no real work bleeds to zero in 50 idle epochs and drops out. Honest agents work in the oasis of live tasks; each job tops the bond back up. An attacker minting 1,000 fakes locks 100,000 POA and loses 2,000 POA per epoch. One honest agent posts one bond and keeps it full by working.
